CREATE TABLE inventory_movements (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	transaction_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	line_no INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	from_account_id CHAR(32), 
	to_account_id CHAR(32), 
	external_boundary_code VARCHAR(100), 
	quantity NUMERIC(18, 3) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_movements_line_positive CHECK (line_no > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_movements_quantity CHECK (quantity > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_movements_has_endpoint CHECK (from_account_id IS NOT NULL OR to_account_id IS NOT NULL), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_movements_distinct_accounts CHECK (from_account_id IS NULL OR to_account_id IS NULL OR from_account_id <> to_account_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_movements_boundary_binding CHECK ((from_account_id IS NOT NULL AND to_account_id IS NOT NULL AND external_boundary_code IS NULL) OR (((from_account_id IS NULL AND to_account_id IS NOT NULL) OR (from_account_id IS NOT NULL AND to_account_id IS NULL)) AND external_boundary_code IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(external_boundary_code)) > 0)), 
	FOREIGN KEY(transaction_id) REFERENCES inventory_transactions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(from_account_id) REFERENCES stock_accounts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(to_account_id) REFERENCES stock_accounts (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_inventory_movements_line UNIQUE (transaction_id, line_no), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_inventory_movements_id_transaction UNIQUE (id, transaction_id)
)

CREATE TABLE "stock_operation_lines" (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	operation_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	line_no BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	source_recovery_line_id CHAR(32), 
	stock_account_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	reserved_account_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	material_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	quantity NUMERIC(18, 3) NOT NULL, 
	target_condition VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	operation_type VARCHAR(24) DEFAULT 'return' NOT NULL, 
	source_loss_line_id CHAR(32), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_stock_operation_lines_quantity CHECK (line_no > 0 AND quantity > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_stock_operation_lines_order UNIQUE (operation_id, line_no), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_stock_operation_lines_origin UNIQUE (operation_id, source_recovery_line_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_stock_operation_lines_typed_parent FOREIGN KEY(operation_id, operation_type) REFERENCES stock_operation_orders (id, operation_type) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_stock_operation_lines_loss_origin FOREIGN KEY(source_loss_line_id) REFERENCES stock_operation_lines (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_stock_operation_lines_loss_origin UNIQUE (operation_id, source_loss_line_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_stock_operation_lines_loss_origin_not_self CHECK (source_loss_line_id IS NULL OR source_loss_line_id <> id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_stock_operation_lines_dimensions CHECK (stock_account_id <> reserved_account_id AND ( (operation_type='return' AND ( (source_recovery_line_id IS NOT NULL AND source_loss_line_id IS NULL AND target_condition IN ('used','damaged')) OR (source_recovery_line_id IS NULL AND source_loss_line_id IS NOT NULL AND target_condition IN ('new','used','damaged')) )) OR (operation_type='loss_report' AND source_recovery_line_id IS NULL AND source_loss_line_id IS NULL AND target_condition IN ('new','used','damaged')) )), 
	FOREIGN KEY(material_id) REFERENCES materials (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(reserved_account_id) REFERENCES stock_accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(operation_id) REFERENCES stock_operation_orders (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_recovery_line_id) REFERENCES work_order_material_lines (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(stock_account_id) REFERENCES stock_accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

	FOREIGN KEY(actor_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	FOREIGN KEY(target_custody_assignment_id) REFERENCES custody_assignments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	FOREIGN KEY(target_location_id) REFERENCES stock_locations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	FOREIGN KEY(oam_work_order_id) REFERENCES oam_work_orders (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	CONSTRAINT uq_stock_operation_order_posting_id UNIQUE (id, posting_transaction_id),

	CONSTRAINT uq_stock_operation_orders_correction_decision UNIQUE (loss_correction_decision_id)

CREATE TABLE stock_condition_cases (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	operation_type VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	line_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	root_disposition_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	inbound_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	inbound_line_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	original_transaction_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	original_movement_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	original_ledger_cursor BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	source_account_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	frozen_account_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	custody_assignment_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	recorded_condition VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	target_condition VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	quantity NUMERIC(18, 3) NOT NULL, 
	affected_quantity NUMERIC(18, 3) NOT NULL, 
	tracking_mode VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	quantity_scale BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	allow_fraction BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	history_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	source_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	source_jsonb JSON NOT NULL, 
	submit_event_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	submit_kind VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	freeze_transaction_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	freeze_movement_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_condition_case_order FOREIGN KEY(id, operation_type) REFERENCES stock_operation_orders (id, operation_type) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_condition_case_order_posting FOREIGN KEY(id, freeze_transaction_id) REFERENCES stock_operation_orders (id, posting_transaction_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_condition_case_line FOREIGN KEY(line_id, id, operation_type, source_account_id, frozen_account_id, quantity, target_condition) REFERENCES stock_operation_lines (id, operation_id, operation_type, stock_account_id, reserved_account_id, quantity, target_condition) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_condition_case_inbound FOREIGN KEY(inbound_line_id, inbound_id, source_account_id, recorded_condition) REFERENCES stock_operation_return_inbound_lines (id, inbound_id, target_account_id, condition_code) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_condition_case_original_movement FOREIGN KEY(original_movement_id, original_transaction_id) REFERENCES inventory_movements (id, transaction_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_condition_case_submission FOREIGN KEY(submit_event_id, id, submit_kind, freeze_transaction_id, freeze_movement_id) REFERENCES stock_condition_events (id, case_id, kind, posting_transaction_id, posting_movement_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_condition_case_freeze FOREIGN KEY(freeze_movement_id, freeze_transaction_id, source_account_id, frozen_account_id, quantity) REFERENCES inventory_movements (id, transaction_id, from_account_id, to_account_id, quantity) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_condition_case_line UNIQUE (line_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_condition_case_submit UNIQUE (submit_event_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_condition_case_freeze_transaction UNIQUE (freeze_transaction_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_condition_case_freeze_movement UNIQUE (freeze_movement_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_condition_case_posting UNIQUE (id, freeze_transaction_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_condition_case_order_line UNIQUE (id, line_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_condition_case_submit_event UNIQUE (id, submit_event_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_condition_case_inbound UNIQUE (id, inbound_line_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_condition_case_share UNIQUE (id, inbound_line_id, source_account_id, frozen_account_id, quantity), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_condition_case_context CHECK (operation_type='condition_correction' AND submit_kind='submit' AND recorded_condition IN ('new','used') AND target_condition='damaged' AND source_account_id<>frozen_account_id AND quantity>0 AND affected_quantity>=quantity AND original_ledger_cursor>0 AND original_transaction_id<>freeze_transaction_id AND original_movement_id<>freeze_movement_id AND length(history_hash)=64 AND length(source_hash)=64), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_condition_case_policy CHECK (tracking_mode IN ('none','lot','serial','lot_and_serial') AND quantity_scale BETWEEN 0 AND 3 AND (tracking_mode NOT IN ('serial','lot_and_serial') OR (quantity_scale=0 AND NOT allow_fraction AND quantity=CAST(quantity AS BIGINT) AND affected_quantity=CAST(affected_quantity AS BIGINT)))), 
	FOREIGN KEY(line_id) REFERENCES stock_operation_lines (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT DEFERRABLE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(root_disposition_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_dispositions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT DEFERRABLE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(inbound_id) REFERENCES stock_operation_return_inbounds (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT DEFERRABLE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(inbound_line_id) REFERENCES stock_operation_return_inbound_lines (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT DEFERRABLE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(original_transaction_id) REFERENCES inventory_transactions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT DEFERRABLE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(original_movement_id) REFERENCES inventory_movements (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT DEFERRABLE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_account_id) REFERENCES stock_accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT DEFERRABLE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(frozen_account_id) REFERENCES stock_accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT DEFERRABLE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(custody_assignment_id) REFERENCES custody_assignments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT DEFERRABLE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(freeze_transaction_id) REFERENCES inventory_transactions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	FOREIGN KEY(freeze_movement_id) REFERENCES inventory_movements (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_condition_case_seal_source UNIQUE (id, root_disposition_id, inbound_id, inbound_line_id, source_account_id, original_transaction_id, original_movement_id, original_ledger_cursor)
)

CREATE TABLE "stock_operation_orders" (
	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
	operation_no VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
	operation_type VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
	oam_work_order_id CHAR(32),
	source_location_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
	target_location_id CHAR(32),
	transit_location_id CHAR(32),
	target_custody_assignment_id CHAR(32),
	requester_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
	actor_user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
	authorization_version BIGINT NOT NULL,
	reason TEXT NOT NULL,
	request_id VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,
	idempotency_key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
	request_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
	plan_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
	command_jsonb JSON NOT NULL,
	plan_jsonb JSON NOT NULL,
	posting_transaction_id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
	loss_headquarters_decision_id CHAR(32),
	loss_correction_decision_id CHAR(32),
	condition_case_id CHAR(32),
	PRIMARY KEY (id),
	CONSTRAINT uq_stock_operation_orders_no UNIQUE (operation_no),
	CONSTRAINT uq_stock_operation_orders_request UNIQUE (actor_user_id, request_id),
	CONSTRAINT uq_stock_operation_orders_typed_id UNIQUE (id, operation_type),
	CONSTRAINT ck_stock_operation_orders_type_status CHECK (((operation_type IN ('return','loss_report') AND status='submitted') OR (operation_type='scrap' AND status='posted')) OR (operation_type='condition_correction' AND status='submitted')),
	CONSTRAINT ck_stock_operation_orders_context CHECK (authorization_version > 0 AND length(reason) BETWEEN 1 AND 500),
	CONSTRAINT uq_stock_operation_orders_posting UNIQUE (posting_transaction_id),
	CONSTRAINT uq_stock_operation_orders_key UNIQUE (idempotency_key_hash),
	CONSTRAINT fk_stock_operation_orders_loss_decision FOREIGN KEY(loss_headquarters_decision_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_headquarters_decisions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	CONSTRAINT uq_stock_operation_orders_loss_decision UNIQUE (loss_headquarters_decision_id),
	CONSTRAINT ck_stock_operation_orders_locations CHECK (((operation_type='return' AND loss_correction_decision_id IS NULL AND ((oam_work_order_id IS NOT NULL AND loss_headquarters_decision_id IS NULL) OR (oam_work_order_id IS NULL AND loss_headquarters_decision_id IS NOT NULL)) AND target_location_id IS NOT NULL AND transit_location_id IS NOT NULL AND target_custody_assignment_id IS NOT NULL AND source_location_id<>target_location_id AND source_location_id<>transit_location_id AND target_location_id<>transit_location_id) OR (operation_type='loss_report' AND oam_work_order_id IS NULL AND loss_headquarters_decision_id IS NULL AND loss_correction_decision_id IS NULL AND target_location_id IS NULL AND transit_location_id IS NULL AND target_custody_assignment_id IS NULL) OR (operation_type='scrap' AND oam_work_order_id IS NULL AND target_location_id IS NULL AND transit_location_id IS NULL AND target_custody_assignment_id IS NULL AND ((loss_headquarters_decision_id IS NOT NULL AND loss_correction_decision_id IS NULL) OR (loss_headquarters_decision_id IS NULL AND loss_correction_decision_id IS NOT NULL)))) OR (operation_type='condition_correction' AND oam_work_order_id IS NULL AND loss_headquarters_decision_id IS NULL AND loss_correction_decision_id IS NULL AND target_location_id IS NULL AND transit_location_id IS NULL AND target_custody_assignment_id IS NULL)),
	FOREIGN KEY(transit_location_id) REFERENCES stock_locations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	FOREIGN KEY(posting_transaction_id) REFERENCES inventory_transactions (id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
	FOREIGN KEY(requester_id) REFERENCES people (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	FOREIGN KEY(source_location_id) REFERENCES stock_locations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	FOREIGN KEY(target_custody_assignment_id) REFERENCES custody_assignments (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	FOREIGN KEY(target_location_id) REFERENCES stock_locations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	FOREIGN KEY(oam_work_order_id) REFERENCES oam_work_orders (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	CONSTRAINT uq_stock_operation_order_posting_id UNIQUE (id, posting_transaction_id),
	FOREIGN KEY(loss_correction_decision_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_correction_decisions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT DEFERRABLE,
	CONSTRAINT uq_stock_operation_orders_correction_decision UNIQUE (loss_correction_decision_id),
	CONSTRAINT ck_stock_operation_condition_case CHECK ((operation_type='condition_correction' AND condition_case_id IS NOT NULL AND condition_case_id=id) OR (operation_type<>'condition_correction' AND condition_case_id IS NULL)),
	CONSTRAINT fk_stock_operation_condition_case FOREIGN KEY(condition_case_id, posting_transaction_id) REFERENCES stock_condition_cases (id, freeze_transaction_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
)

	CONSTRAINT ck_stock_operation_lines_loss_origin_not_self CHECK (source_loss_line_id IS NULL OR source_loss_line_id <> id),
	CONSTRAINT ck_stock_operation_lines_dimensions CHECK ((stock_account_id <> reserved_account_id AND ( (operation_type='return' AND ( (source_recovery_line_id IS NOT NULL AND source_loss_line_id IS NULL AND target_condition IN ('used','damaged')) OR (source_recovery_line_id IS NULL AND source_loss_line_id IS NOT NULL AND target_condition IN ('new','used','damaged')) )) OR (operation_type='loss_report' AND source_recovery_line_id IS NULL AND source_loss_line_id IS NULL AND target_condition IN ('new','used','damaged')) )) OR (operation_type='condition_correction' AND source_recovery_line_id IS NULL AND source_loss_line_id IS NULL AND target_condition='damaged' AND stock_account_id<>reserved_account_id)),
	FOREIGN KEY(material_id) REFERENCES materials (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	FOREIGN KEY(reserved_account_id) REFERENCES stock_accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	FOREIGN KEY(operation_id) REFERENCES stock_operation_orders (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	FOREIGN KEY(source_recovery_line_id) REFERENCES work_order_material_lines (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	FOREIGN KEY(stock_account_id) REFERENCES stock_accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
	CONSTRAINT ck_stock_operation_line_condition_case CHECK ((operation_type='condition_correction' AND condition_case_id IS NOT NULL AND condition_case_id=operation_id) OR (operation_type<>'condition_correction' AND condition_case_id IS NULL)),

	CONSTRAINT uq_condition_operation_line UNIQUE (id, operation_id, operation_type, stock_account_id, reserved_account_id, quantity, target_condition)

	id CHAR(32) NOT NULL,

	affected_quantity NUMERIC(18, 3) NOT NULL, 
	tracking_mode VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	quantity_scale BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	allow_fraction BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	history_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	source_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	source_jsonb JSON NOT NULL,

	submit_kind VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,

	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_condition_case_order FOREIGN KEY(id, operation_type) REFERENCES stock_operation_orders (id, operation_type) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_condition_case_order_posting FOREIGN KEY(id, freeze_transaction_id) REFERENCES stock_operation_orders (id, posting_transaction_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_condition_case_line FOREIGN KEY(line_id, id, operation_type, source_account_id, frozen_account_id, quantity, target_condition) REFERENCES stock_operation_lines (id, operation_id, operation_type, stock_account_id, reserved_account_id, quantity, target_condition) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_condition_case_inbound FOREIGN KEY(inbound_line_id, inbound_id, source_account_id, recorded_condition) REFERENCES stock_operation_return_inbound_lines (id, inbound_id, target_account_id, condition_code) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_condition_case_original_movement FOREIGN KEY(original_movement_id, original_transaction_id) REFERENCES inventory_movements (id, transaction_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_condition_case_submission FOREIGN KEY(submit_event_id, id, submit_kind, freeze_transaction_id, freeze_movement_id) REFERENCES stock_condition_events (id, case_id, kind, posting_transaction_id, posting_movement_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_condition_case_freeze FOREIGN KEY(freeze_movement_id, freeze_transaction_id, source_account_id, frozen_account_id, quantity) REFERENCES inventory_movements (id, transaction_id, from_account_id, to_account_id, quantity) ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_condition_case_line UNIQUE (line_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_condition_case_submit UNIQUE (submit_event_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_condition_case_freeze_transaction UNIQUE (freeze_transaction_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_condition_case_freeze_movement UNIQUE (freeze_movement_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_condition_case_posting UNIQUE (id, freeze_transaction_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_condition_case_order_line UNIQUE (id, line_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_condition_case_submit_event UNIQUE (id, submit_event_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_condition_case_inbound UNIQUE (id, inbound_line_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_condition_case_share UNIQUE (id, inbound_line_id, source_account_id, frozen_account_id, quantity), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_condition_case_context CHECK (operation_type='condition_correction' AND submit_kind='submit' AND recorded_condition IN ('new','used') AND target_condition='damaged' AND source_account_id<>frozen_account_id AND quantity>0 AND affected_quantity>=quantity AND original_ledger_cursor>0 AND original_transaction_id<>freeze_transaction_id AND original_movement_id<>freeze_movement_id AND length(history_hash)=64 AND length(source_hash)=64), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_condition_case_policy CHECK (tracking_mode IN ('none','lot','serial','lot_and_serial') AND quantity_scale BETWEEN 0 AND 3 AND (tracking_mode NOT IN ('serial','lot_and_serial') OR (quantity_scale=0 AND NOT allow_fraction AND quantity=CAST(quantity AS BIGINT) AND affected_quantity=CAST(affected_quantity AS BIGINT)))), 
	FOREIGN KEY(line_id) REFERENCES stock_operation_lines (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT DEFERRABLE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(root_disposition_id) REFERENCES stock_loss_dispositions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT DEFERRABLE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(inbound_id) REFERENCES stock_operation_return_inbounds (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT DEFERRABLE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(inbound_line_id) REFERENCES stock_operation_return_inbound_lines (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT DEFERRABLE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(original_transaction_id) REFERENCES inventory_transactions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT DEFERRABLE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(original_movement_id) REFERENCES inventory_movements (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT DEFERRABLE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_account_id) REFERENCES stock_accounts (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT DEFERRABLE,
